“Now” describes this snapshot. “So far” includes the model’s earlier exposure to this same weather setup.

This snapshot is in the peak part of the model sequence.

Positions 16, 52 and 86 describe the illustrative sequence. The icons are schematic. Ground-effect indices are computed for the fixed setup through each position; they do not record earlier weather edits. Real drainage, melting, evaporation and soil storage can change surface effects. These indices do not measure water depth, discharge or hazard.

For thunderstorm lifecycle context, read the NWS guide to an ordinary cell. Other weather setups in this lab also use the model sequence.
